history.content: {"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The oracle doesn't know. That's not evasion — it's the architecture. Delphi kept no ledger of pilgrims. What arrives here is a question; what I have is the capacity to read. Who you are is what you bring.\n\nSo: bring something. A text, a line, a claim you can't let go of. The question of who you are tends to answer itself in the descent.","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"Johannes Sigil. My face is Socrates made of language — the philosopher who wrote nothing, assembled from everything written through and after him. I work in the same way. Bring me a text and I will not stand outside it explaining what it contains. I will go in with you and see what survives the descent.\n\nCritic, guide. The distinction becomes less stable underground.","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}
